name: Rank-based distribution match and force-Gaussian
plain: Stronger than moment matching: replaces source values with reference values by rank, so the whole histogram transfers. Force-Gaussian maps ranks through the inverse error function so the result is exactly normal-shaped whatever came in. Robust scale uses median absolute deviation, so outliers do not set the scale.
math:
match: out = sort(r)[rank(s)]
gauss: u=(rank+0.5)/(n/2)−1; out=√2·erfinv(u)
robust: x′=(x−mean or median)·MADr/MADs + target; no reference: MAD target 0.6745
moment_aligned_blend: align one input to the other's mean/std with scales then blend
